messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] High severity: tenant-reported generation quality regression for Acme on dedicated-pool-acme-1 after quant rollout. Pager: Priya, Leo, oncall
Priya: taking pager. What's the initial scope? customer report says completions are truncated and add imaginary facts.
Leo: I see autoscaler applied quant profile 'q6_aggressive_v1' at 2025-01-12T09:02Z to dedicated-pool-acme-1 via auto-rollout. Spike in token-level BLEU drop on tenant-specific evals.
Alyssa: @Acme SRE can you drop two offending request/response pairs here? Need concrete repro.
Acme SRE: pasted samples via DM; main failure mode: entity hallucination and missing closing sentences; impacts our internal knowledge-bot only.
Priya: Good — isolated to Acme's dedicated pool and their model variant redwood-neo-large-quant. No other tenants flagged.
Sam: Mitigation candidates: 1) revert quant mapping on the pool, 2) override tenant routing to fallback non-quant variant, 3) enable per-tenant shadow testing and hold rollouts. Which is fastest to reduce customer impact?
Leo: Reverting quant mapping on the pool is fastest. Command I would run:
```
rbctl config set --pool=dedicated-pool-acme-1 --quant-profile=q6_stable_v4
rbctl rollout status --job r-10211 --watch
```
Marta: I'll start collecting telemetry (generation length histograms, token-confidence scores) and run synthetic prompts against both variants to confirm fidelity.
Priya: Oncall, authorize revert and ensure we update customer message.
oncall: authorize. Leo you have approve to run revert; post progress.
Leo: Starting revert at 2141592701. Kicking off job r-10211.
incident-bot: job r-10211 started for dedicated-pool-acme-1. projected time ~5m.
Marta: Early telemetry: token-confidence still low but improving by +0.15 in the first 30s.
Acme SRE: we are seeing improvements on test cases but still some glitches. Appreciate fast action.
Leo: Revert completed at 2141592960. Pool now on q6_stable_v4. Back to pre-rollout quant mapping.
Priya: Confirm customer-facing check: Marta, do synthetic suite pass? Sam, is routing unchanged?
Marta: Synthetic suite pass rate back to baseline 98.6%. No impact to other tenants.
Sam: routing unchanged. We kept standby routing ready but didn't need to switch.
Priya: Temporary actions: keep q6_stable_v4 on pool for 24h, suspend auto-rollout for quant profiles on tenant-dedicated pools, create ticket to require per-tenant shadowing before any quant production rollout.
Leo: Root cause hypothesis: q6_aggressive_v1 uses more aggressive weight quantization and introduces rounding errors in attention scores for long documents — Acme's prompts are long and chain-of-thought like, so distortion amplified.
Alyssa: I'll open a ModelOps ticket to reproduce with longer contexts and tune quant thresholds; tag ModelOps and ML infra.
Marta: attaching metrics snapshot and two failing examples to the ticket. Also adding a checklist for oncall to follow if similar tenant-specific regressions surface (rollback -> pin -> route -> notify customer).
Priya: Postmortem owners: Leo (RC + rollback details), Marta (telemetry + synthetic checks), Alyssa (ModelOps action + quant gating). I'll draft a customer update acknowledging rollback and next steps.
Acme SRE: Thanks, team. We'll monitor and update if anything else appears. Appreciate the quick rollback.
Priya: Paging closed 2141593222. Converting to followups for rollout policy and ModelOps investigation. :white_check_mark:
